## Part A
```{r}
#A1

v_len <- length(v)
v_mean <- mean(v)
v_sum <- sum(v)
print(v)
print(v_len)
print(v_mean)
print(v_sum)
```

```{r}
#A2

z <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = 4)
print(w)
print(z)
```


## Part B
```{r}
#B1
students <- data.frame(
  id = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(students)
```

```{r}
#B2
structure(students)
dim.data.frame(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)
```

```{r}
#B3
students$average <- round((students$midterm + students$final) / 2, 1)
print(students$average)
```

```{r}
#B4
students$passed <- (students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75)
print(students$passed)
```

```{r}
#B5
students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors", ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Suppport"))
print(students$standing)
```

```{r}
#B6
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    return("Distinction")
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else {
  return("Fail")
  }
}
result <- sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
print(result)
```

## Part C
```{r}
#C1
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average <- round((new_students$midterm + new_students$final) / 2, 1)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 & new_students$attendance >= 75
new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                         ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
print(students_all)
```

```{r}
#C2
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)

students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)

class(students_all)
```

```{r}
#C3
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)

m_means <- colMeans(m)
m <- rbind(m, mean = m_means)

print(m)
```

```{r}
#C4
bad <- data.frame(id = 11, student_name = "Alex", score = 90)

tryCatch(rbind(students, bad), error = function(e) { message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
```

## Part E
```{r}
#E1
students_all$section <- factor(students_all$section)
students_all$sex <- factor(students_all$sex)
levels(students_all$section)
levels(students_all$sex)
```

```{r}
#E2
table(students_all$sex)
table(students_all$section)
table(students_all$sex, students_all$section)
```

```{r}
#E3
as.integer(students_all$sex)
#The integers in the code represents the order of internal number (basing on the order of the alphabet). The integer "1" represents "Female" while "2" indicates "Male".
```

```{r}
#E4
students_all$sex_label <- factor(students_all$sex, levels = c("F", "M"), labels = c("Female", "Male"))
levels(students_all$sex_label)
```

```{r}
#E5
summary(students_all$sex_label)
mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Female"])
mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Male"])
```
